title: L1 Mobility Support  (India – Bangalore)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: IT Desktop Support
Job type and Location: Full time - 5 days/week Bangalore
12month contract

Technical

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (GraphQL)
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer GraphQL
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: Hybrid 2x Days onsite - (Mon/Tues) Hyderabad, India

Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Full Stack Engineer GraphQL to join a growing engineering team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will play a key part in designing and building a Server-Driven UI (SDUI) framework that enables dynamic, scalable, and cross-platform user experiences across Web, iOS, and Android applications. You will collaborate closely with global teams to deliver robust GraphQL APIs and backend services that support rapid product iteration and flexible UI rendering.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect and develop scalable GraphQL APIs to deliver dynamic UI schemas and content
  • Build and maintain backend services and tooling that support Server-Driven UI (SDUI) across platforms
  • Collaborate with web and mobile engineers to ensure seamless integration and rendering of server-driven components
  • Design, define, and evolve schema models and metadata for dynamic UI delivery
  • Optimise backend systems for performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Contribute to technical strategy, architecture, and platform-wide UI delivery decisions
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices
  • Participate in code reviews and actively drive engineering excellence
  • Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • All other duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications
  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Engineer with a focus on modern web technologies
  • Mandatory expertise in:
    • TypeScript
    • React
    • GraphQL
  • Experience building applications across both web and mobile platforms
  • Solid understanding of API design, microservices, and scalable system architecture
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Java for backend development
  • Exposure to design systems, component libraries, or platform engineering
  • Prior experience working with Server-Driven UI (SDUI) or similar architectures
  • Experience in mobile development (web and/or native)
  • Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities
  • Experience within the Financial Services domain

title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
description:
Role: Lead Salesforce Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 5 months
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: 100% Remote, but must be in office for 1st weeks (Wed/Thurs) - Hyderabad, India

Overview
The Lead Salesforce Engineer will provide development leadership and technical direction for a Salesforce Service Cloud implementation supporting contact center operations. You will design and build scalable solutions, guide best practices, and deliver integrations and enhancements that improve customer experience across a global, multi-site environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Architect complex technical Cloud CRM solutions on Salesforce/Force.com.
  • Design and deliver advanced customizations using Apex, Lightning (Aura/LWC), and JavaScript.
  • Integrate multiple cloud and on-premise technologies with the Salesforce platform, including extensive API-based integrations.
  • Operate partially within the US Eastern time zone to align with US-based teams.
  • Deliver day-to-day code changes and enhancements on the Salesforce CRM platform.
  • Guide project team members to ensure Salesforce best practices are embedded in the solution.
  • Run workshops with business teams and communicate configuration vs code trade-offs.
  • Translate functional requirements into Salesforce features and technical designs.
  • Mentor junior engineers in Salesforce development, integrations, and best practices.
  • Oversee vendor and internal team code reviews and quality standards.
  • Serve as application SME for global deployment; educate stakeholders on current and planned capabilities aligned to the Salesforce product roadmap.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications
  • 8+ years' experience as a developer on an enterprise CRM solution (Salesforce).
  • 6+ years' experience as a Salesforce Developer within Service Cloud.
  • Current Salesforce Developer and Administration certifications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex Classes/Triggers, Apex test frameworks (Mocks/Test classes), enterprise patterns, and Lightning (Components + LWC).
  • Extensive experience integrating Salesforce with third-party systems via APIs.
  • Experience leading and mentoring technical resources and contributing to large-scale implementations.
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience implementing digital contact center solutions such as Omni-Channel, Email, and Social.
  • Experience with Platform Events, AppExchange products, and Batch Apex.
  • Salesforce Agentforce experience.
  • NICE call center CTI integration experience.
  • Integration experience with AWS.
  • Salesforce GenAI exposure.
  • Experience in e-commerce and other fast-paced environments.
  • Agile delivery experience.

title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
Role: Senior iOS Developer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long-term Contract
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: Hybrid 2x days onsite (Mon/Tues) - Hyderabad, India


Overview
We are seeking a Senior iOS Developer to join a Native Platform Team responsible for app-wide iOS architecture and shared native functionality. This role focuses on building and modernizing core infrastructure such as deep linking, analytics, and foundational frameworks that support the entire mobile application.

You will work within a large, long-lived iOS codebase that continues to evolve with modern Apple frameworks and best practices. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, comfort navigating complex systems, and the ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to resolution.

Key Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the development and evolution of a flagship native iOS application
  • Design, implement, and improve app-wide iOS architecture and shared platform components
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new platform capabilities
  • Ensure application performance, quality, stability, and responsiveness at scale
  • Identify architectural bottlenecks, technical debt, and systemic issues; propose and implement improvements
  • Maintain high standards for code quality, organization, testing, and automation
  • Mentor junior developers and provide guidance on iOS best practices
  • Lead and participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding and architectural standards
  • Coordinate with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to understand requirements and deliver solutions
  • Participate in sprint planning and agile development ceremonies
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, and challenges to stakeholders
  • Stay current with iOS platform trends, frameworks, and emerging technologies
  • All other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional iOS application development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Swift and Objective?C
  • Hands-on experience with SwiftUI and UIKit
  • Deep understanding of Apple's design principles and interface guidelines
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs with iOS applications
  • Proficiency with Git or similar version control systems
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex issues
  • Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in large, legacy iOS codebases undergoing modernization
  • Background in platform or infrastructure-focused mobile development
  • Experience mentoring developers or leading technical initiatives

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long-term Contract
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Location: Hybrid 1x days onsite (Thursday) - Hyderabad, India

We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Developer (Tech Lead) to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications. This role combines hands-on engineering with team leadership, requiring expertise in Java, Spring Boot microservices, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and mentor junior developers while driving best practices across engineering initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performing applications using Java and Spring Boot
  • Build and manage microservices-based architectures with a focus on reliability and scalability
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services using Spring Boot and JPA/Hibernate
  • Implement and manage build and deployment processes using Gradle
  • Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data structures
  • Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Leverage AWS cloud services for deployment, monitoring, and scaling of applications
  • Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues, bugs, and system challenges
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and code reviews for junior developers
  • Drive adoption of best practices in coding standards, architecture, and design patterns
  • All other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java (8 or above) in enterprise application development
  • Proven experience building Spring Boot microservices architectures
  • Experience working with JPA/Hibernate
  • Hands-on experience using Gradle for build automation
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and distributed systems
  • Solid knowledge of SQL, database design, and performance optimization
  • Working knowledge of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)
  • Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and testing frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to lead and mentor development teams

Preferred Qualifications
  • AWS certification (Developer or Solutions Architect) or Oracle certification
  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with modern DevOps practices
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
